name: Top Of Your Game
source:
Top of Your Game is an 2D anime inspired anthology series that present a different story and different set of characters each chapter.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/ellofatdog]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
《Top of Your Game》是一部受日本动画启发的2D短篇集，每一章都会呈现不同的故事和一组全新的角色。

[来源：[url=https://www.patreon.com/ellofatdog]Patreon[/url]]
